Creamy Tomato Soup: Melt butter; sweat the minced onion with salt and pepper. Add garlic, crushed red pepper, and smoked paprika; sprinkle in flour and cook until sizzling. Add the tomatoes (crush by hand) with their juice, plus stock, thyme, sugar, and the ancho chile; simmer covered on medium-low until the tomatoes break down. Pluck out thyme and ancho, then blend until creamy; blend in a little deseeded chile for more smoke if you like. Top bowls with crema and chives.
Vegetarian Mushroom Shawarma Pitas: Heat oven to 425F. Toss mushrooms and red onion with olive oil, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and pepper; roast until tender and browned, warming the pitas in the oven at the end. Toss cabbage with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Stir yogurt with turmeric, salt, and pepper. Slather yogurt on the warm pitas; top with cabbage, mushrooms, and cilantro or mint.
buddha bowl: Roast large-diced sweet potato at 425F until tender. Roast sliced portobello and large-diced red onion tossed with olive oil, cumin, coriander, and paprika until browned. Cook rice. Whisk tahini with lemon juice and garlic, thinning with water to a drizzle. Build bowls: rice, sweet potato, mushrooms and onion, black beans, spinach, avocado; drizzle with tahini sauce.
black-eye pea salad: Cook the black-eyed peas in vegetable stock; drain and cool. Dice carrot and cucumber, slice green onion, dice jalapeno, halve the cherry tomatoes, chop cilantro. Toast the sesame seeds. Toss everything with olive oil and vinegar, salt and pepper.
roasted veggie bowls: Cook rice in vegetable stock. Roast diced red onion, diced sweet potato, and broccoli florets tossed with olive oil, salt, and pepper at 425F until browned. Whisk tahini with lemon and garlic. Cook the shrimp. Build bowls with rice, roasted veg, and shrimp; drizzle with tahini sauce.
asian cucumber thai salad: Whisk the dressing: rice vinegar, fish sauce, sugar, minced ginger, coriander, red pepper flakes. Halve, seed, and slice the cucumber; slice green onion; small-dice the tomato; chop cilantro; chiffonade the mint. Toast the peanuts. Toss everything with the dressing; top with peanuts.
salad and salmon: Cook the salmon. Shred the lettuce; slice cucumber, red onion, and avocado. Whisk olive oil and vinegar for the dressing. Plate greens with cucumber, onion, and avocado; top with salmon and dress.
marry me chickpea: Cook rice. Sweat the small-diced shallot with garlic; add paprika, oregano, red pepper flakes, tomato paste, and diced sun-dried tomato. Add chickpeas, vegetable stock, and coconut milk; simmer to a creamy sauce. Finish with lemon juice. Serve over rice.
tumeric chickpea soup: Sweat diced onion with garlic, ginger, and small-diced serrano; add turmeric. Add chickpeas, vegetable stock, and coconut milk; simmer. Stir in chiffonaded kale until wilted. Finish with lime.
corn salad: Combine corn, small-diced tomato and bell pepper, black beans, chiffonaded green onion and basil, and kalamata olives. Toss with olive oil and vinegar; top with crumbled feta.
tuna melt: Mix tuna with mayonnaise, brunoised red onion and celery, and chopped parsley. Build sandwiches on buttered bread with the tuna salad, sliced tomato, and cheese; griddle until the cheese melts and the bread is golden.
chicken brocolli and rice: Cook rice. Roast broccoli florets tossed with olive oil at 425F until browned. Make gravy: cook butter and flour into a roux, whisk in chicken stock, and simmer to thicken. Assemble containers with rice, cooked chicken, and broccoli; top with gravy.
tacos: Warm the carnitas and cook the salmon. Chop cilantro and small-dice onion. Build tacos on tortillas with carnitas or salmon, onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.
salmon and roasted veg: Roast diced red onion, diced sweet potato, and broccoli florets with olive oil, salt, and pepper at 425F. Cook the salmon alongside. Serve the salmon over the roasted vegetables.
Indian Vegetarian (batch): Sweat diced onion in butter with garlic; add cumin, garam masala, red chili powder, and turmeric. Add stewed tomatoes and the cooked urad dal; simmer. Stir in heavy cream and kasuri methi to finish.
butternut squash soup (batch): Roast diced butternut squash until browned. Sweat diced onion; add oregano and thyme. Add the roasted squash and vegetable stock; simmer. Blend with cream cheese until smooth; brighten with a splash of vinegar.
vegetable stock: Roughly dice onion, celery, and carrot. Simmer with bay leaf and thyme in water until deeply flavored; strain.
cucumber salad: Smash the cucumbers and dry-brine with salt to draw out water; drain. Toss with rice vinegar, soy sauce, sesame oil, and minced garlic.
meat spaghetti: Brown the ground beef, then add marinara and simmer the sauce. Cook the spaghetti. Combine, and finish with parmesan.
meat spaghetti (micah): Brown the ground beef, then add marinara and simmer the sauce. Cook the spaghetti. Combine, and finish with parmesan.
chicken stock: Simmer the rotisserie chicken with large-diced onion and carrot in water until rich; strain.
Smoked Pork Shoulder (batch): Trim the pork shoulders and coat with mustard, salt, and pepper. Smoke low and slow until probe-tender, then wrap and rest before shredding.
spinach meatballs batch: Mix ground beef with thawed chopped spinach, egg, breadcrumbs, and minced garlic. Form into meatballs and cook until browned and done through.
spinach egg bites (batch): Blend eggs with ricotta and parmesan; fold in thawed chopped spinach and breadcrumbs. Pour into muffin cups and bake until set.
hamburgers: Cook the patties (beef and Impossible) and melt cheese on top. Bake the fries. Build burgers on buns with lettuce and sliced onion.
lox, eggs and onions: Sweat diced onion; add the lox to warm through, then the beaten eggs and softly scramble.
bok choy: Halve the baby bok choy and saute with garlic until crisp-tender.
roasted broccoli: Break broccoli into florets, toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper, and roast at 425F until browned and crisp at the edges.
roasted carrots: Toss diced carrots with olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast at 425F until caramelized.
roasted sweet potatoes: Toss large-diced sweet potato with olive oil, salt, and pepper; roast at 425F until tender and browned.
salmon bites: Cut salmon into bite-size pieces, season, and cook until just done.
indian with rice: Cook rice in vegetable stock. Serve the Indian meat and vegetable dishes over the rice.
